title: The sign by day, two letters
logline: The tavern's sign in daylight, close on the two dead tubes: gray glass shapes the page draws so carefully the reader could almost read them, and doesn't. The bird's page a month later sits on a third. Three letters withheld three ways.

panels.composition: Extreme close-up of two dead neon tubes on a tavern sign in daylight, gray glass shapes drawn carefully against the sign's painted face, the letters' forms almost legible.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an extreme close-up of two dead neon tubes on a tavern's sign in daylight drawn as careful gray glass shapes against the painted face, almost but not legible, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
